topic: Anthropic unlocked Mythos 5 inside Claude Security with scan results only and no prompt box — the interface is the new safety layer; shrinking the attack surface beats making the model smarter.
tweet_text:
the best AI safety move of 2026 isn't a safer model.

it's a smaller surface.

anthropic just unlocked Mythos 5 inside Claude Security. scan results only, no prompt box. can't steer toward exploits.

the interface is the new safety layer.

#AI #AISafety
prompt: a single dark sleek monitor on a black desk displaying a glowing green scan results interface with circular status indicators and bar charts, the keyboard area replaced by a flat brushed steel plate where input should be, dramatic single overhead key light, deep black background, cinematic moody atmosphere, photorealistic editorial photography, 35mm, shallow depth of field, no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks
concept_rationale: Visualizes the 'smaller surface' thesis literally: the monitor shows the scan results (the safe output side) but the input has been physically removed — replaced by a flat brushed steel plate. The absence of a keyboard is the safety layer. Deep black void + cinematic key light + green scan-result glow is the bold-mood default for Twitter scroll-stopping, and 16:9 lets the image carry the contrarian 'interface is the new safety layer' reframe without any overlay dependency.
alt_text: A single dark sleek monitor on a black desk displaying a glowing green scan results interface with circular status indicators and bar charts, while the keyboard area in front has been replaced by a flat brushed steel plate — visualizing the smaller surface.
